models_evaluated: six frontier AI systems including web-augmented systems

links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of LLMs versus surgeon specialists on same vignettes
links.effect: GPT-5 accuracy 95.3% vs specialist consensus 92.7% and GPT-4o 82.0% (P<0.001); in pediatric/geriatric vignettes GPT-5 93.8%, specialists 90.0%, GPT-4o 71.2%.
links.quote: GPT-5 achieved the highest accuracy (95.3%), exceeding GPT-4o (82.0%; P < 0.001) and slightly surpassing specialist consensus (92.7%).

links.outcome: Search-induced hallucinations in web-augmented LLM systems
links.effect: Error analysis identified search-induced hallucinations in web-augmented systems as a distinct failure mode.
links.quote: Error analysis identified distinct failure modes, including search-induced hallucinations in web-augmented systems.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM diagnostic accuracy, triage safety, and error failure modes on standardized clinical vignettes compared to general surgeons, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
